purpose: SUPPLEMENTARY raw-input re-score of the EXISTING capacity-probe export (model sha 91941897), over the SAME 607-row manifest sha 5fded590, under the SAME evaluator image. Exactly ONE thing changes: MEDZEN_SCORE_INPUT_CONVENTION=raw, so the evaluator feeds the waveform the way TRAINING fed it (_raw_wave) instead of the normalized contract path (_preprocess_wave). No retraining, no model change, no new data, no new selection. WHY: the probe trained on RAW audio but was scored on NORMALIZED audio, so the frozen F_fit = 39.57 is correct for the normalized path and says nothing about how well the model fits the input preparation it actually trained on. This separates a scoring-input mismatch from genuinely weak fitting. The frozen PARTIAL_FIT result is NOT revised by this job under any outcome: this number is reported NEXT TO it as a supplementary measurement, never as a replacement.
